# paddle_subscription_cancel (Action)

Cancels a Paddle subscription. See [Paddle API Reference](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/subscriptions/cancel-subscription). **Canceling can't be undone** (Paddle's own words: "You can't reinstate a canceled subscription"). Checks the subscription's current status first and skips the call entirely if it's already `canceled`, rather than erroring or re-invoking. No `paddle_subscription` resource exists in this provider — subscriptions are checkout-created, not declared in Terraform — so `subscription_id` is a plain string, not a resource reference.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# See examples/lookup-then-act/main.tf for the full
# `resource "terraform_data" { lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } } }`
# wiring that actually invokes this action.

action "paddle_subscription_cancel" "example" {
  config {
    subscription_id = "sub_..."     # replace with a real subscription ID
    effective_from  = "immediately" # immediately or next_billing_period
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `effective_from` (String) When the cancellation takes effect: `immediately` or `next_billing_period`. Required (no default applied here) even though Paddle defaults to `next_billing_period` server-side if omitted — deliberately, so an irreversible immediate cancellation is never an implicit choice.
- `subscription_id` (String) The subscription to cancel (prefix `sub_...`).
